test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow's from the gives statements.

**Statements :**

All phones are flowers.

Some flowers are bags.

All bags are heavy.

**Conclusion I : **Some phones are flowers.

**Conclusion II :** All flowers are bags.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8803ed5e151397f6d5d1d8becaf36a456f137eb53dde9e750aedf6917c507133.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some phones are flowers → Follow (As all phones are flowers. So, as whole phones comes in flowers therefore it is definitely true)

II. All flowers are bags → Does not follow (As some flowers are bags. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) is follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion (I) is follows".
